executive_summary_zh: 今天候选内容整体信号较弱，只有一条与 AI 编程代理运营度量直接相关的原始技术更新值得关注。
最有价值的信息不是新能力发布，而是 GitHub 披露了 Copilot agent usage metrics 的归因缺陷：部分 IDE 将 agent 会话迁移到 Copilot SDK 后丢失了 IDE 标识，导致企业报表低估 agent 活动。
对工程平台负责人而言，这提示 AI 编程采用度量仍高度依赖客户端埋点与版本一致性，任何 IDE/SDK 升级都可能影响管理层看到的 ROI 仪表盘。
executive_summary_en: The candidate set is weak today; only one item stands out as a meaningful primary-source update for AI coding operations.

The key signal is not a new feature but GitHub's disclosure of an attribution bug in Copilot agent usage metrics: after some IDEs moved agent sessions to the Copilot SDK, missing IDE identifiers caused undercounting of agent activity.

For platform and engineering leaders, this is a reminder that AI coding adoption metrics depend heavily on client instrumentation and version hygiene, so IDE/SDK upgrades can directly distort executive ROI dashboards.

items.title: Update your IDE to restore agent activity in Copilot usage metrics
items.summary_zh: GitHub 说明 Copilot usage metrics 中的 agent activity 与 agent lines of code 曾出现异常下降，原因是若干 IDE 把 agent mode 会话迁移到 Copilot SDK 后，没有正确上报来源 IDE 标识，导致这些会话无法被仪表盘和 API 正确归因；部分流量甚至被算入 Copilot CLI。修复已在 VS Code 提供，其他 IDE 将陆续发布；但开发者在修复前产生的未归因活动无法事后恢复。
items.summary_en: GitHub disclosed that drops in Copilot agent activity and agent lines-of-code metrics were caused by an attribution issue: after some IDEs moved agent-mode sessions onto the Copilot SDK, those sessions stopped identifying their source IDE, so dashboards and APIs could not attribute them correctly. Some usage was even counted as Copilot CLI activity. A fix is available in VS Code and will roll out to other IDEs, but activity lost before the upgrade cannot be recovered.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这条更新的重要性在于它揭示了 AI 编程组织化落地中最脆弱的一层：度量基础设施。很多团队正用 agent 使用量、代码行数、活跃用户和工具分布来判断推广效果、制定席位预算和评估培训成果。如果客户端 SDK、IDE 版本或埋点字段变化就能让关键指标失真，那么任何关于“采用下降”或“ROI 不成立”的结论都可能是错误的。对平台团队来说，这比功能发布更值得立即处理。
items.why_it_matters_en: This matters because it exposes a fragile layer in enterprise AI-coding adoption: measurement infrastructure. Many teams use agent activity, lines-of-code, active-user counts, and tool mix to justify rollout, budget seats, and assess enablement. If SDK and IDE version changes can distort those numbers, conclusions about declining adoption or weak ROI may be wrong. For platform teams, that is more urgent than a feature announcement.
key_takeaways_zh: Copilot agent 会话迁移到 Copilot SDK 后，如果未携带 IDE 标识，会导致 usage metrics 仪表盘和 API 低估 agent 活动。
修复依赖开发者升级到指定 IDE 版本，且历史遗漏数据无法补回，因此企业需要把 IDE 版本治理纳入 AI 工具度量策略。
key_takeaways_en: When agent sessions moved to the Copilot SDK without preserving IDE identity, Copilot usage dashboards and APIs undercounted agent activity.
The fix depends on developers upgrading to specific IDE versions, and missed historical activity cannot be backfilled, so enterprises need IDE version governance as part of AI tooling measurement.

implications_zh: 如果你在做 Copilot 或 agent rollout，需要重新校验最近数周的采用率下滑是否只是埋点归因问题，而非真实行为变化。
平台团队应建立 AI 开发工具的最低受支持 IDE 版本策略，并把度量完整性检查纳入升级流程。
面向管理层展示 AI ROI 时，应明确区分“真实使用变化”和“观测口径变化”，避免误导预算与组织决策。
implications_en: If you are running a Copilot or agent rollout, re-check whether recent adoption declines were instrumentation artifacts rather than real behavior changes.
Platform teams should define minimum supported IDE versions for AI tooling and include metric-integrity checks in upgrade rollout processes.
When presenting AI ROI to leadership, explicitly separate real usage changes from observability changes to avoid misleading budget and org decisions.
